correctness.rationale: Read RESULT.md and verifier. Properness gives distinct colours within each s-clique blade and excludes hub colour; every blade vertex automatically has odd multiplicity one for all neighbour colours. Hub parity is exactly a binary m-by-q incidence matrix of row weight s and each column with positive odd weight. If m odd q=s attained by repeating same s colours; for even m, odd col sums <=m-1 and q even imply q >= 2ceil(ms/(2(m-1))). At equality choose positive odd col sums totaling ms, possible as even increments up to m-1; Gale-Ryser inequalities hold since min(k,d)>=kd/m for 0<=d<=m and uniform row degrees s, proving attainability. Fourier signs on parity masks produce full named-palette count with (s!)^m hub assignment factors. Special m odd, m2, s2 even formulas follow exactly. Independent parity-mask dynamic programming vs Fourier sum passed 32 parameter pairs, smaller palette exclusions; no infinite extrapolation.
